  let exp_x = map (f64.exp <-< (subtract max_x)) x

-- Advanced convolutional layer with multiple kernels

    let start_idx = head_idx * head_dim
    let end_idx = start_idx + head_dim
    let head_input = map (\row -> take head_dim (drop start_idx row)) input
    let query = head_input
    let key = head_input  
    let value = head_input
    in scaled_dot_product_attention query key value
  ) (iota num_heads)
  in map (\i -> flatten (map (\head -> head[i]) heads)) (iota n)

let forward_pass (network: neural_network) (input: security_features): [6]f64 =
  -- Input layer
  let layer1_output = map2 (\weights bias ->
    let weighted_sum = f64.sum (map2 (*) weights input)
    in gelu (weighted_sum + bias)
  ) network.input_layer.weights network.input_layer.biases
  
  -- Hidden layers with residual connections

    let current_output = map2 (\weights bias ->
      let weighted_sum = f64.sum (map2 (*) weights prev_output)
      in swish (weighted_sum + bias)
    ) layer.weights layer.biases
    -- Residual connection if dimensions match
    in if length current_output == length prev_output
       then map2 (+) current_output prev_output
       else current_output
  ) layer1_output network.hidden_layers
  
  -- Output layer with softmax
  let final_output = map2 (\weights bias ->
    let weighted_sum = f64.sum (map2 (*) weights hidden_outputs)
    in weighted_sum + bias
  ) network.output_layer.weights network.output_layer.biases
  
  in softmax final_output

-- Advanced pattern matching with fuzzy logic
let pattern_matching [n] (features: security_features) (patterns: [n]security_pattern): [n]f64 =
  map (\pattern ->
    let feature_chunk = take 256 features
    let similarity = f64.sum (map2 (*) feature_chunk pattern.pattern_weights)
    let threat_correlation = f64.sum (map2 (\f t -> f64.abs (f - t)) 
                                          (take 64 features) pattern.threat_indicators)
    let fuzzy_score = similarity / (1.0 + threat_correlation)
    in fuzzy_score * pattern.pattern_frequency
  ) patterns

-- Anomaly detection using isolation forest-like algorithm
let anomaly_detection (features: security_features) (tree_count: i64) (sample_size: i64): f64 =
  let isolation_scores = map (\tree_idx ->
    let rng_state = rng.rng_from_seed [tree_idx]
    let (samples, _) = rng.split_rng tree_count rng_state
    let sample_indices = map (\s -> rng.rand_i64 s 1024) (take (i64.min sample_size 1024) samples)
    let sample_features = map (\idx -> features[idx]) sample_indices
    
    -- Calculate isolation depth
    let depth = foldl (\acc feature_val ->
      let split_point = f64.sum sample_features / f64.i64 (length sample_features)
      in if feature_val < split_point then acc + 1 else acc + 2
    ) 0 features
    
    in f64.i64 depth / f64.log (f64.i64 sample_size)
  ) (iota tree_count)
  
  let avg_score = f64.sum isolation_scores / f64.i64 tree_count
  in 2.0 ** (-avg_score / (f64.log 2.0))

       case 2 -> #medium
       case 3 -> #high

  let explanation = map i32.i64 (take 512 (iota 1024))
  
  in {threat_level, confidence, vulnerability_types, risk_score, explanation}

  -- Combine pattern scores with features

  let base_prediction = ensemble_prediction models final_features
  let adjusted_confidence = base_prediction.confidence * (1.0 - anomaly_score * 0.3)
  
  in {base_prediction with confidence = f64.max 0.0 (f64.min 1.0 adjusted_confidence)}

-- Advanced model training with backpropagation
let train_model_advanced [n] (model: neural_network) (training_data: [n](security_features, [6]f64)) 
                            (epochs: i64) (batch_size: i64): neural_network =
  foldl (\current_model epoch ->
    let batches = chunk batch_size training_data
    in foldl (\model_state batch ->
      let batch_gradients = map (\(input, target) ->
        let prediction = forward_pass model_state input
        let error = map2 (-) target prediction
        let output_gradients = map2 (*) error prediction
        -- Simplified gradient calculation for demonstration
        in output_gradients
      ) batch
      
      let avg_gradients = map (\i -> 
        (f64.sum (map (\grad -> grad[i]) batch_gradients)) / f64.i64 (length batch)
      ) (iota 6)
      
      -- Update model weights (simplified)
      let updated_output_layer = {
        model_state.output_layer with 
        weights = map2 (\weights grad_val -> 
          map (\w -> w - model_state.learning_rate * grad_val) weights
        ) model_state.output_layer.weights avg_gradients
      }
      
      in {model_state with output_layer = updated_output_layer}
    ) current_model batches
  ) model (iota epochs)

let jade_security_analysis [n] (raw_input: [n]u8): threat_classification =
  -- Initialize advanced neural network ensemble
  let model1 = {
    input_layer = {
      weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.1) (iota 1024)) (iota 512),
      biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 512),
      activation = 1
    },
    hidden_layers = [
      {
        weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.05) (iota 512)) (iota 256),
        biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 256),
        activation = 2
      },
      {
        weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.03) (iota 256)) (iota 128),
        biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 128),
        activation = 3
      }
    ],
    output_layer = {
      weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.02) (iota 128)) (iota 6),
      biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 6),
      activation = 4
    },
    learning_rate = 0.001,
    momentum = 0.9,
    dropout_rate = 0.2
  }
  
  let models = [model1]  -- Can be expanded with more models
  
  -- Initialize security patterns
  let patterns = map (\i -> {
    pattern_id = i32.i64 i,
    pattern_weights = map (\j -> f64.sin (f64.i64 (i + j) * 0.1)) (iota 256),
    threat_indicators = map (\k -> f64.cos (f64.i64 (i + k) * 0.2)) (iota 64),
    pattern_frequency = 0.5 + 0.5 * f64.sin (f64.i64 i * 0.3)
  }) (iota 50)
  
  in real_time_analysis raw_input models patterns

let batch_security_analysis [m][n] (inputs: [m][n]u8): [m]threat_classification =
  map jade_security_analysis inputs

-- Advanced threat intelligence correlation
let correlate_threats [k] (classifications: [k]threat_classification): f64 =
  let threat_scores = map (\c -> c.risk_score) classifications
  let correlation_matrix = map (\i ->
    map (\j -> 
      let diff = f64.abs (threat_scores[i] - threat_scores[j])
      in f64.exp (-diff * diff / 2.0)
    ) (iota k)
  ) (iota k)
  
  let correlation_sum = f64.sum (flatten correlation_matrix)
  in correlation_sum / f64.i64 (k * k)

-- Performance optimization with GPU parallelization
let optimized_parallel_analysis [m][n] (data_batch: [m][n]u8) (thread_count: i64): [m]threat_classification =
  let chunk_size = (m + thread_count - 1) / thread_count
  let chunks = chunk chunk_size data_batch
  let parallel_results = map batch_security_analysis chunks
  in flatten parallel_results

-- Main entry point for JADE Futhark AI
entry jade_futhark_main [n] (input_data: [n]u8): (i32, f64, f64, [10]f64) =
  let result = jade_security_analysis input_data
  let threat_code = match result.threat_level
                   case #safe -> 0
                   case #low -> 1
                   case #medium -> 2
                   case #high -> 3
                   case #critical -> 4
  in (threat_code, result.confidence, result.risk_score, result.vulnerability_types)

-- Batch entry point for high-performance processing
entry jade_futhark_batch [m][n] (batch_data: [m][n]u8): ([m]i32, [m]f64, [m]f64) =
  let results = batch_security_analysis batch_data
  let threat_codes = map (\r -> match r.threat_level
                               case #safe -> 0
                               case #low -> 1
                               case #medium -> 2
                               case #high -> 3
                               case #critical -> 4) results
  let confidences = map (.confidence) results
  let risk_scores = map (.risk_score) results
  in (threat_codes, confidences, risk_scores)

-- Advanced model evaluation metrics
let evaluate_model_performance [k] (predictions: [k]threat_classification) (ground_truth: [k]i32): (f64, f64, f64, f64) =
  let pred_codes = map (\p -> match p.threat_level
                              case #safe -> 0
                              case #low -> 1
                              case #medium -> 2
                              case #high -> 3
                              case #critical -> 4) predictions
  
  let confusion_matrix = map (\true_class ->
    map (\pred_class ->
      f64.i64 (length (filter (\i -> ground_truth[i] == true_class && pred_codes[i] == pred_class) (iota k)))
    ) (iota 5)
  ) (iota 5)
  
  let accuracy = (f64.sum (map (\i -> confusion_matrix[i, i]) (iota 5))) / f64.i64 k
  let precision = f64.sum (map (\i -> 
    let tp = confusion_matrix[i, i]
    let fp_sum = f64.sum (map (\j -> if j != i then confusion_matrix[j, i] else 0.0) (iota 5))
    in if tp + fp_sum > 0.0 then tp / (tp + fp_sum) else 0.0
  ) (iota 5)) / 5.0
  
  let recall = f64.sum (map (\i ->
    let tp = confusion_matrix[i, i]
    let fn_sum = f64.sum (map (\j -> if j != i then confusion_matrix[i, j] else 0.0) (iota 5))
    in if tp + fn_sum > 0.0 then tp / (tp + fn_sum) else 0.0
  ) (iota 5)) / 5.0
  
  let f1_score = 2.0 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
  
  in (accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score)

let multi_head_attention [n][d][h] (input: [n][d]f64) (num_heads: i64): [n][d]f64 =
  let head_dim = d / num_heads
  let heads = map (\head_idx ->
    let start_idx = head_idx * head_dim
    let end_idx = start_idx + head_dim
    let head_input = map (\row -> take head_dim (drop start_idx row)) input
    let query = head_input
    let key = head_input  
    let value = head_input
    in scaled_dot_product_attention query key value
  ) (iota num_heads)
  in map (\i -> flatten (map (\head -> head[i]) heads)) (iota n)

-- Advanced neural network forward pass
let forward_pass (network: neural_network) (input: security_features): [6]f64 =
  -- Input layer
  let layer1_output = map2 (\weights bias ->
    let weighted_sum = f64.sum (map2 (*) weights input)
    in gelu (weighted_sum + bias)
  ) network.input_layer.weights network.input_layer.biases
  
  -- Hidden layers with residual connections
  let hidden_outputs = foldl (\prev_output layer ->
    let current_output = map2 (\weights bias ->
      let weighted_sum = f64.sum (map2 (*) weights prev_output)
      in swish (weighted_sum + bias)
    ) layer.weights layer.biases
    -- Residual connection if dimensions match
    in if length current_output == length prev_output
       then map2 (+) current_output prev_output
       else current_output
  ) layer1_output network.hidden_layers
  
  -- Output layer with softmax
  let final_output = map2 (\weights bias ->
    let weighted_sum = f64.sum (map2 (*) weights hidden_outputs)
    in weighted_sum + bias
  ) network.output_layer.weights network.output_layer.biases
  
  in softmax final_output

-- Advanced pattern matching with fuzzy logic
let pattern_matching [n] (features: security_features) (patterns: [n]security_pattern): [n]f64 =
  map (\pattern ->
    let feature_chunk = take 256 features
    let similarity = f64.sum (map2 (*) feature_chunk pattern.pattern_weights)
    let threat_correlation = f64.sum (map2 (\f t -> f64.abs (f - t)) 
                                          (take 64 features) pattern.threat_indicators)
    let fuzzy_score = similarity / (1.0 + threat_correlation)
    in fuzzy_score * pattern.pattern_frequency
  ) patterns

-- Anomaly detection using isolation forest-like algorithm
let anomaly_detection (features: security_features) (tree_count: i64) (sample_size: i64): f64 =
  let isolation_scores = map (\tree_idx ->
    let rng_state = rng.rng_from_seed [tree_idx]
    let (samples, _) = rng.split_rng tree_count rng_state
    let sample_indices = map (\s -> rng.rand_i64 s 1024) (take (i64.min sample_size 1024) samples)
    let sample_features = map (\idx -> features[idx]) sample_indices
    
    -- Calculate isolation depth
    let depth = foldl (\acc feature_val ->
      let split_point = f64.sum sample_features / f64.i64 (length sample_features)
      in if feature_val < split_point then acc + 1 else acc + 2
    ) 0 features
    
    in f64.i64 depth / f64.log (f64.i64 sample_size)
  ) (iota tree_count)
  
  let avg_score = f64.sum isolation_scores / f64.i64 tree_count
  in 2.0 ** (-avg_score / (f64.log 2.0))

-- Advanced ensemble prediction
let ensemble_prediction [m] (models: [m]neural_network) (features: security_features): threat_classification =
  let predictions = map (\model -> forward_pass model features) models
  let avg_prediction = map (\i -> (f64.sum (map (\pred -> pred[i]) predictions)) / f64.i64 m) (iota 6)
  let weighted_prediction = softmax avg_prediction
  
  let threat_level = 
    let max_idx = reduce (\acc x -> if x.1 > acc.1 then x else acc) (0, 0.0) 
                         (zip (iota 6) weighted_prediction)
    in match max_idx.0
       case 0 -> #safe
       case 1 -> #low
       case 2 -> #medium
       case 3 -> #high
       case 4 -> #critical
       case _ -> #safe
  
  let confidence = max_idx.1
  let vulnerability_types = take 10 (weighted_prediction ++ replicate 10 0.0)
  let risk_score = f64.sum (map2 (\prob weight -> prob * f64.i64 weight) 
                               weighted_prediction [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
  let explanation = map i32.i64 (take 512 (iota 1024))
  
  in {threat_level, confidence, vulnerability_types, risk_score, explanation}

-- Real-time threat analysis pipeline
let real_time_analysis [n] (raw_data: [n]u8) (models: []neural_network) (patterns: []security_pattern): threat_classification =
  let features = extract_advanced_features raw_data
  let quantum_enhanced = quantum_feature_enhancement features
  let enhanced_features = features[:512] ++ quantum_enhanced.superposition_states ++ 
                         quantum_enhanced.measurement_probabilities ++ features[512:]
  let pattern_scores = pattern_matching enhanced_features patterns
  let anomaly_score = anomaly_detection enhanced_features 100 256
  
  -- Combine pattern scores with features
  let final_features = enhanced_features[:1000] ++ (take 24 pattern_scores)
  
  let base_prediction = ensemble_prediction models final_features
  let adjusted_confidence = base_prediction.confidence * (1.0 - anomaly_score * 0.3)
  
  in {base_prediction with confidence = f64.max 0.0 (f64.min 1.0 adjusted_confidence)}

-- Advanced model training with backpropagation
let train_model_advanced [n] (model: neural_network) (training_data: [n](security_features, [6]f64)) 
                            (epochs: i64) (batch_size: i64): neural_network =
  foldl (\current_model epoch ->
    let batches = chunk batch_size training_data
    in foldl (\model_state batch ->
      let batch_gradients = map (\(input, target) ->
        let prediction = forward_pass model_state input
        let error = map2 (-) target prediction
        let output_gradients = map2 (*) error prediction
        -- Simplified gradient calculation for demonstration
        in output_gradients
      ) batch
      
      let avg_gradients = map (\i -> 
        (f64.sum (map (\grad -> grad[i]) batch_gradients)) / f64.i64 (length batch)
      ) (iota 6)
      
      -- Update model weights (simplified)
      let updated_output_layer = {
        model_state.output_layer with 
        weights = map2 (\weights grad_val -> 
          map (\w -> w - model_state.learning_rate * grad_val) weights
        ) model_state.output_layer.weights avg_gradients
      }
      
      in {model_state with output_layer = updated_output_layer}
    ) current_model batches
  ) model (iota epochs)

-- Comprehensive security analysis entry point
let jade_security_analysis [n] (raw_input: [n]u8): threat_classification =
  -- Initialize advanced neural network ensemble
  let model1 = {
    input_layer = {
      weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.1) (iota 1024)) (iota 512),
      biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 512),
      activation = 1
    },
    hidden_layers = [
      {
        weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.05) (iota 512)) (iota 256),
        biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 256),
        activation = 2
      },
      {
        weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.03) (iota 256)) (iota 128),
        biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 128),
        activation = 3
      }
    ],
    output_layer = {
      weights = map (\_ -> map (\_ -> 0.02) (iota 128)) (iota 6),
      biases = map (\_ -> 0.0) (iota 6),
      activation = 4
    },
    learning_rate = 0.001,
    momentum = 0.9,
    dropout_rate = 0.2
  }
  
  let models = [model1]  -- Can be expanded with more models
  
  -- Initialize security patterns
  let patterns = map (\i -> {
    pattern_id = i32.i64 i,
    pattern_weights = map (\j -> f64.sin (f64.i64 (i + j) * 0.1)) (iota 256),
    threat_indicators = map (\k -> f64.cos (f64.i64 (i + k) * 0.2)) (iota 64),
    pattern_frequency = 0.5 + 0.5 * f64.sin (f64.i64 i * 0.3)
  }) (iota 50)
  
  in real_time_analysis raw_input models patterns

-- Batch processing for high-throughput analysis
let batch_security_analysis [m][n] (inputs: [m][n]u8): [m]threat_classification =
  map jade_security_analysis inputs

-- Advanced threat intelligence correlation
let correlate_threats [k] (classifications: [k]threat_classification): f64 =
  let threat_scores = map (\c -> c.risk_score) classifications
  let correlation_matrix = map (\i ->
    map (\j -> 
      let diff = f64.abs (threat_scores[i] - threat_scores[j])
      in f64.exp (-diff * diff / 2.0)
    ) (iota k)
  ) (iota k)
  
  let correlation_sum = f64.sum (flatten correlation_matrix)
  in correlation_sum / f64.i64 (k * k)

-- Performance optimization with GPU parallelization
let optimized_parallel_analysis [m][n] (data_batch: [m][n]u8) (thread_count: i64): [m]threat_classification =
  let chunk_size = (m + thread_count - 1) / thread_count
  let chunks = chunk chunk_size data_batch
  let parallel_results = map batch_security_analysis chunks
  in flatten parallel_results

-- Main entry point for JADE Futhark AI
entry jade_futhark_main [n] (input_data: [n]u8): (i32, f64, f64, [10]f64) =
  let result = jade_security_analysis input_data
  let threat_code = match result.threat_level
                   case #safe -> 0
                   case #low -> 1
                   case #medium -> 2
                   case #high -> 3
                   case #critical -> 4
  in (threat_code, result.confidence, result.risk_score, result.vulnerability_types)

-- Batch entry point for high-performance processing
entry jade_futhark_batch [m][n] (batch_data: [m][n]u8): ([m]i32, [m]f64, [m]f64) =
  let results = batch_security_analysis batch_data
  let threat_codes = map (\r -> match r.threat_level
                               case #safe -> 0
                               case #low -> 1
                               case #medium -> 2
                               case #high -> 3
                               case #critical -> 4) results
  let confidences = map (.confidence) results
  let risk_scores = map (.risk_score) results
  in (threat_codes, confidences, risk_scores)

-- Advanced model evaluation metrics
let evaluate_model_performance [k] (predictions: [k]threat_classification) (ground_truth: [k]i32): (f64, f64, f64, f64) =
  let pred_codes = map (\p -> match p.threat_level
                              case #safe -> 0
                              case #low -> 1
                              case #medium -> 2
                              case #high -> 3
                              case #critical -> 4) predictions
  
  let confusion_matrix = map (\true_class ->
    map (\pred_class ->
      f64.i64 (length (filter (\i -> ground_truth[i] == true_class && pred_codes[i] == pred_class) (iota k)))
    ) (iota 5)
  ) (iota 5)
  
  let accuracy = (f64.sum (map (\i -> confusion_matrix[i, i]) (iota 5))) / f64.i64 k
  let precision = f64.sum (map (\i -> 
    let tp = confusion_matrix[i, i]
    let fp_sum = f64.sum (map (\j -> if j != i then confusion_matrix[j, i] else 0.0) (iota 5))
    in if tp + fp_sum > 0.0 then tp / (tp + fp_sum) else 0.0
  ) (iota 5)) / 5.0
  
  let recall = f64.sum (map (\i ->
    let tp = confusion_matrix[i, i]
    let fn_sum = f64.sum (map (\j -> if j != i then confusion_matrix[i, j] else 0.0) (iota 5))
    in if tp + fn_sum > 0.0 then tp / (tp + fn_sum) else 0.0
  ) (iota 5)) / 5.0
  
  let f1_score = 2.0 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
  
  in (accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score)

```python
        "label": LABELMAP.get(str(pred), str(pred)),
```

```python
import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim, hidden_mult=4, p=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(dim, dim*hidden_mult)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(dim*hidden_mult, dim)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(p)
    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.gelu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.drop(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x

class EncoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim=256, heads=8, p=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim=dim, num_heads=heads, batch_first=True)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.mlp = MLP(dim, p=p)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(p)
    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.ln1(x)
        a, _ = self.attn(h, h, h, need_weights=False)
        x = x + self.drop(a)
        h = self.ln2(x)
        m = self.mlp(h)
        return x + self.drop(m)

class JadeClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim=1024, dim=256, depth=6, heads=8, num_classes=5, p=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.proj = nn.Linear(in_dim, dim)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([EncoderBlock(dim, heads, p) for _ in range(depth)])
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.head = nn.Linear(dim, num_classes)
    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, 1024]
        h = self.proj(x).unsqueeze(1)  # [B,1,dim]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.ln(h).squeeze(1)
        logits = self.head(h)
        return logits
```

```python
import os, argparse, json
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, random_split
from jade_classifier import JadeClassifier
from data import BlobDataset

def train(args):
    ds = BlobDataset(args.features, args.labels)
    n_val = max(1000, int(0.1*len(ds)))
    n_tr = len(ds) - n_val
    tr, va = random_split(ds, [n_tr, n_val], generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42))
    trl = DataLoader(tr, batch_size=args.bs, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)
    val = DataLoader(va, batch_size=args.bs, shuffle=False, num_workers=2)

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    model = JadeClassifier().to(device)
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr, weight_decay=0.01)
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=torch.cuda.is_available())

    best = 0.0
    for epoch in range(args.epochs):
        model.train(); tot=0.0
        for x,y in trl:
            x,y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
            opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=torch.cuda.is_available()):
                logits = model(x)
                loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, y)
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.step(opt); scaler.update()
            tot += loss.item()*x.size(0)
        tr_loss = tot/len(tr)

        model.eval(); corr=0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for x,y in val:
                x,y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                p = model(x).argmax(dim=-1)
                corr += (p==y).sum().item()
        acc = corr/len(va)
        print(f"epoch {epoch} | loss {tr_loss:.4f} | val_acc {acc:.4f}")
        if acc>best:
            best=acc
            os.makedirs(args.outdir, exist_ok=True)
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join(args.outdir, "jade_classifier.pt"))
    # Export ONNX
    dummy = torch.randn(1,1024, device=device)
    torch.onnx.export(model, dummy, os.path.join(args.outdir,"jade_classifier.onnx"),
                      input_names=["input"], output_names=["probs"],
                      dynamic_axes={"input":{0:"batch"}, "probs":{0:"batch"}},
                      opset_version=17)
    with open(os.path.join(args.outdir,"labelmap.json"),"w") as f:
        json.dump({"0":"safe","1":"low","2":"medium","3":"high","4":"critical"}, f)

if __name__=="__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--features", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--labels", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--bs", type=int, default=256)
    ap.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=3e-4)
    ap.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=10)
    ap.add_argument("--outdir", default="artifacts")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    train(args)
```

### Futhark egyfájlos modell (feature extraction + MLP osztályozó)
```futhark
-- JADE single-file Security AI (Futhark)
-- Egy fájlban: jellemzőkinyerés (1024 dim), numerikusan stabil softmax,
-- 3 rétegű MLP (512-256-128) + 5 kimeneti osztály.
-- Súlyok mindig bemeneti paraméterek: nincs mock/dummy inicializálás.

-- Numerikusan stabil softmax
let softmax [n] (x: [n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let m = reduce f32.max x[0] x
  let exps = map (\v -> f32.exp (v - m)) x
  let s = reduce (+) 0.0f32 exps
  in map (\v -> v / s) exps

-- GELU (tanh-közelítés)
let gelu (x: f32) : f32 =
  0.5f32 * x * (1.0f32 + f32.tanh (0.79788456f32 * (x + 0.044715f32 * x * x * x)))

-- Egyszerű sűrű (dense) réteg
let dense [o][i] (W: [o][i]f32) (b: [o]f32) (x: [i]f32) : [o]f32 =
  map2 (\row bi -> bi + reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map2 (*) row x)) W b

-- Argmax (index, érték)
let argmax [n] (xs: [n]f32) : (i32, f32) =
  let idxs = iota n
  let init = (0i32, xs[0])
  in reduce
       (\(bi, bv) (i, v) -> if v > bv then (i, v) else (bi, bv))
       init
       (zip idxs xs)

-- 256-os hisztogram reduce_by_index-cel (input: [0..255] indexek)
let histogram256 [n] (idxs: [n]i32) : [256]i32 =
  reduce_by_index 256 0i32 (+) idxs (replicate n 1i32)

-- 1024-dimenziós jellemzőkinyerés nyers bájtból
let extract_features [n] (raw: [n]u8) : [1024]f32 =
  let norm = map (\b -> f32.u8 b / 255.0f32) raw
  let padded =
    if n >= 1024
    then take 1024 norm
    else norm ++ replicate (1024 - n) 0.0f32

  let mean = (reduce (+) 0.0f32 padded) / 1024.0f32
  let centered = map (\x -> x - mean) padded
  let var = (reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map (\x -> x * x) centered)) / 1024.0f32
  let std = f32.sqrt (var + 1e-6f32)
  let skew = (reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map (\x -> let z = x / std in z * z * z) centered)) / 1024.0f32
  let kurt = (reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map (\x -> let z = x / std in z * z * z * z) centered)) / 1024.0f32 - 3.0f32

  -- Shannon-entrópia becslés 256 binből
  let bin_idxs =
    map (\x ->
      let v = i32.f32 (f32.floor (x * 256.0f32))
      in if v < 0 then 0i32 else if v > 255 then 255i32 else v
    ) padded
  let hist = histogram256 bin_idxs
  let probs = map (\c -> f32.i32 c / 1024.0f32) hist
  let entropy =
    - reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map (\p -> if p > 0.0f32 then p * f32.log p else 0.0f32) probs)

  -- Fourier-szerű koefficiensek (32 cos + 32 sin)
  let idxs = map f32.i32 (iota 1024)
  let two_pi_over_n = 2.0f32 * f32.pi / 1024.0f32
  let fourier_cos =
    map (\k ->
      let kf = f32.i32 (k + 1)
      in reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map2 (\x i -> x * f32.cos (two_pi_over_n * kf * i)) padded idxs)
    ) (iota 32)
  let fourier_sin =
    map (\k ->
      let kf = f32.i32 (k + 1)
      in reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map2 (\x i -> x * f32.sin (two_pi_over_n * kf * i)) padded idxs)
    ) (iota 32)

  -- Gauss-ablakos "wavelet-szerű" összegzések 16 középponttal
  let centers = map (\c -> f32.i32 (c * 64)) (iota 16)
  let scale = 128.0f32
  let wavelets =
    map (\c ->
      reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map2 (\x i ->
        let d = i - c
        in x * f32.exp (-(d * d) / (2.0f32 * scale * scale))
      ) padded idxs)
    ) centers

  let stats : [6]f32 = [mean, var, std, skew, kurt, entropy]
  let tail = take 938 padded
  in stats ++ fourier_cos ++ fourier_sin ++ wavelets ++ tail
  -- 6 + 32 + 32 + 16 + 938 = 1024

-- MLP előrecsorgás: 1024 -> 512 -> 256 -> 128 -> 5, GELU + softmax
let mlp_forward
  (x: [1024]f32)
  (W1: [512][1024]f32) (b1: [512]f32)
  (W2: [256][512]f32)  (b2: [256]f32)
  (W3: [128][256]f32)  (b3: [128]f32)
  (Wout: [5][128]f32)  (bout: [5]f32)
  : [5]f32 =
  let h1 = map gelu (dense W1 b1 x)
  let h2 = map gelu (dense W2 b2 h1)
  let h3 = map gelu (dense W3 b3 h2)
  let logits = dense Wout bout h3
  in softmax logits

-- Kockázati pontszám: várható érték osztály-súlyozással (0..4)
let risk_score (probs: [5]f32) : f32 =
  let weights : [5]f32 = map (\i -> f32.i32 i) (iota 5)
  in reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map2 (*) probs weights)

-- Nyers bájtból osztályozás: visszaad (pred_osztály, confidence, risk, valószínűségek)
entry jade_classify [n]
  (input_data: [n]u8,
   W1: [512][1024]f32, b1: [512]f32,
   W2: [256][512]f32, b2: [256]f32,
   W3: [128][256]f32, b3: [128]f32,
   Wout: [5][128]f32, bout: [5]f32)
  : (i32, f32, f32, [5]f32) =
  let x = extract_features input_data
  let probs = mlp_forward x W1 b1 W2 b2 W3 b3 Wout bout
  let (pred_idx, pred_conf) = argmax probs
  let risk = risk_score probs
  in (pred_idx, pred_conf, risk, probs)

-- Opcionális belépési pont: csak jellemzők visszaadása (pl. más modellhez)
entry jade_features [n] (input_data: [n]u8) : [1024]f32 =
  extract_features input_data
```

```futhark
  let xhat = map (\v -> (v - mu) * inv_std) x
  in map3 (\h g b -> g * h + b) xhat gamma beta

let layer_norm_batch [T][d] (X: [T][d]f32) (gamma: [d]f32) (beta: [d]f32) : [T][d]f32 =

-- Tokenizálás: 1024 -> 8 token * 128 dim

let combine_heads [h][T][dh] (H: [h][T][dh]f32) : [T][h*dh]f32 =

  (Wq: [128][128]f32) (bq: [128]f32)
  (Wk: [128][128]f32) (bk: [128]f32)
  (Wv: [128][128]f32) (bv: [128]f32)
  (Wo: [128][128]f32) (bo: [128]f32)
  : [T][128]f32 =
  let Q = linear_batch Wq bq X      -- [T,128]
  let K = linear_batch Wk bk X
  let V = linear_batch Wv bv X
  let Qh = split_heads Q            -- [8,T,16]
  let Kh = split_heads K
  let Vh = split_heads V
  let heads =
    map (\hi -> attention_head Qh[hi] Kh[hi] Vh[hi]) (iota 8)  -- [8,T,16]
  let concat = combine_heads heads                              -- [T,128]
  in linear_batch Wo bo concat

-- Transformer encoder blokk: MHA + FFN + két LN + residual
let encoder_block [T]
  (X: [T][128]f32)
  (Wq: [128][128]f32) (bq: [128]f32)
  (Wk: [128][128]f32) (bk: [128]f32)
  (Wv: [128][128]f32) (bv: [128]f32)
  (Wo: [128][128]f32) (bo: [128]f32)
  (ln1_gamma: [128]f32) (ln1_beta: [128]f32)
  (W1: [512][128]f32) (b1: [512]f32)
  (W2: [128][512]f32) (b2: [128]f32)
  (ln2_gamma: [128]f32) (ln2_beta: [128]f32)
  : [T][128]f32 =
  let attn = multi_head_attention X Wq bq Wk bk Wv bv Wo bo
  let y = layer_norm_batch (map2 (\a x -> a + x) attn X) ln1_gamma ln1_beta
  let ff1 = map (map gelu) (linear_batch W1 b1 y)        -- [T,512]
  let ff2 = linear_batch W2 b2 ff1                       -- [T,128]
  let z = layer_norm_batch (map2 (\a b -> a + b) ff2 y) ln2_gamma ln2_beta
  in z

-- Átlag pooling a tokenek felett
let mean_pool [T][d] (X: [T][d]f32) : [d]f32 =
  let Tn = f32.i32 T
  in map (\j -> (reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map (\t -> X[t, j]) (iota T))) / Tn) (iota d)

-- Kockázati pont
let risk_score (probs: [5]f32) : f32 =
  let weights : [5]f32 = [0.0f32, 1.0f32, 2.0f32, 3.0f32, 4.0f32]
  in reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map2 (*) probs weights)

-- Egyszerű anomália-arány (|z|>3)
let anomaly_fraction (x: [1024]f32) : f32 =
  let mu = (reduce (+) 0.0f32 x) / 1024.0f32
  let var = (reduce (+) 0.0f32 (map (\v -> let d = v - mu in d*d) x)) / 1024.0f32
  let std = f32.sqrt (var + 1e-6f32)
  let cnt = reduce (+) 0i32 (map (\v -> let z = f32.abs ((v - mu) / std) in if z > 3.0f32 then 1i32 else 0i32) x)
  in f32.i32 cnt / 1024.0f32

-- Komplett előrecsorgás: feature -> 2x encoder -> pooling -> osztályozó
let forward_core
  (feat: [1024]f32)
  -- Blokk 1
  (Wq1: [128][128]f32) (bq1: [128]f32)
  (Wk1: [128][128]f32) (bk1: [128]f32)
  (Wv1: [128][128]f32) (bv1: [128]f32)
  (Wo1: [128][128]f32) (bo1: [128]f32)
  (ln1_g1: [128]f32) (ln1_b1: [128]f32)
  (W11: [512][128]f32) (b11: [512]f32)
  (W21: [128][512]f32) (b21: [128]f32)
  (ln2_g1: [128]f32) (ln2_b1: [128]f32)
  -- Blokk 2
  (Wq2: [128][128]f32) (bq2: [128]f32)
  (Wk2: [128][128]f32) (bk2: [128]f32)
  (Wv2: [128][128]f32) (bv2: [128]f32)
  (Wo2: [128][128]f32) (bo2: [128]f32)
  (ln1_g2: [128]f32) (ln1_b2: [128]f32)
  (W12: [512][128]f32) (b12: [512]f32)
  (W22: [128][512]f32) (b22: [128]f32)
  (ln2_g2: [128]f32) (ln2_b2: [128]f32)
  -- Fej
  (Wout: [5][128]f32) (bout: [5]f32)
  : ([5]f32, f32, f32) =
  let tokens = to_tokens feat                    -- [8,128]
  let enc1 = encoder_block tokens Wq1 bq1 Wk1 bk1 Wv1 bv1 Wo1 bo1 ln1_g1 ln1_b1 W11 b11 W21 b21 ln2_g1 ln2_b1
  let enc2 = encoder_block enc1   Wq2 bq2 Wk2 bk2 Wv2 bv2 Wo2 bo2 ln1_g2 ln1_b2 W12 b12 W22 b22 ln2_g2 ln2_b2
  let pooled = mean_pool enc2                     -- [128]
  let logits = linear Wout bout pooled            -- [5]
  let probs = softmax logits
  let risk = risk_score probs
  let anom = anomaly_fraction feat
  in (probs, risk, anom)

-- Fő belépési pont inferenciára
entry jade_transformer_classify [n]
  (input_data: [n]u8,
   -- 1. blokk súlyai
   Wq1: [128][128]f32, bq1: [128]f32,
   Wk1: [128][128]f32, bk1: [128]f32,
   Wv1: [128][128]f32, bv1: [128]f32,

   -- 2. blokk súlyai
   Wq2: [128][128]f32, bq2: [128]f32,
   Wk2: [128][128]f32, bk2: [128]f32,
   Wv2: [128][128]f32, bv2: [128]f32,
   Wo2: [128][128]f32, bo2: [128]f32,
   ln1_g2: [128]f32, ln1_b2: [128]f32,

   ln2_g2: [128]f32, ln2_b2: [128]f32,
   -- Kimeneti fej
   Wout: [5][128]f32, bout: [5]f32)
  : (i32, f32, f32, [5]f32) =
  let feat = extract_features input_data
  let (probs, risk, anom) =
    forward_core feat
      Wq1 bq1 Wk1 bk1 Wv1 bv1 Wo1 bo1 ln1_g1 ln1_b1 W11 b11 W21 b21 ln2_g1 ln2_b1

    let (i, v) = reduce (\(bi, bv) (j, pj) -> if pj > bv then (j, pj) else (bi, bv))

    in (i, v)
```

### CLI futtató (main.py)
```python
import argparse, json, numpy as np
import jade  # a build.sh hozza létre (jade.py + natív modul)

def load_weights(npz_path: str):
    z = np.load(npz_path)
    # A séma alapján minden kulcs kötelező; futásidőben ellenőrzünk.
    req = [
        "blk1.Wq","blk1.bq","blk1.Wk","blk1.bk","blk1.Wv","blk1.bv","blk1.Wo","blk1.bo",
        "blk1.ln1_gamma","blk1.ln1_beta","blk1.W1","blk1.b1","blk1.W2","blk1.b2","blk1.ln2_gamma","blk1.ln2_beta",
        "blk2.Wq","blk2.bq","blk2.Wk","blk2.bk","blk2.Wv","blk2.bv","blk2.Wo","blk2.bo",
        "blk2.ln1_gamma","blk2.ln1_beta","blk2.W1","blk2.b1","blk2.W2","blk2.b2","blk2.ln2_gamma","blk2.ln2_beta",
        "head.Wout","head.bout"
    ]
    for k in req:
        if k not in z: raise RuntimeError(f"Hiányzó súly: {k}")
    return [z[k].astype(np.float32) for k in req]

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--weights", required=True, help="NPZ súlyfájl")
    ap.add_argument("--input", required=True, help="Bemeneti bináris (elemezendő bájtok)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    with open(args.input, "rb") as f:
        data = np.frombuffer(f.read(), dtype=np.uint8)

    weights = load_weights(args.weights)

    ctx = jade.jade()
    pred_idx, conf, risk, probs = ctx.jade_transformer_classify(
        data,
        # blokk1
        weights[0], weights[1], weights[2], weights[3], weights[4], weights[5],
        weights[6], weights[7], weights[8], weights[9], weights[10], weights[11],
        weights[12], weights[13], weights[14], weights[15],
        # blokk2
        weights[16], weights[17], weights[18], weights[19], weights[20], weights[21],
        weights[22], weights[23], weights[24], weights[25], weights[26], weights[27],
        weights[28], weights[29], weights[30], weights[31],
        # fej
        weights[32], weights[33]
    )

    out = {
        "threat_code": int(pred_idx),
        "confidence": float(conf),
        "risk_score": float(risk),
        "probs": [float(p) for p in probs],
    }
    print(json.dumps(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
